name: Incompatible response structure change
description: A provider returns a restructured JSON payload that breaks downstream field mapping.
expected_effect: Field mapping failure in downstream consumers

name: Hidden business regression
description: Logic change causes silently incorrect order routing that is only visible through business-metric drift.
expected_effect: Silent misrouting detected only via KPI drift

name: Edge-case behavior change
description: Boundary input that previously succeeded now triggers a validation error after a library update.
expected_effect: Validation rejects previously valid boundary inputs

name: Pipeline branch break
description: A conditional branch in the processing pipeline silently becomes unreachable after a refactor.
expected_effect: Dead branch leaves subset of orders unprocessed

name: Partial contract violation
description: Only a subset of response fields violate the contract, leaving overall structure intact but values incorrect.
expected_effect: Partial field value corruption passes structural checks
